Channels and shapes: an MCP etendo_update fills an empty mandate; a /sws/neo/batch create stores it (batch is create-only, so the create path; a probe operation reads the row and fails the batch, which rolls back); a create in a data envelope stores it (searchKey sent: the handler's placeholder only goes to the top level); a type inherited from the contact category (contact-category-type rules on) decides it — customer category yes, vendor-only no; GET defaults carries today's signature date only with the flag on.
